def submission : Goal := by
  intro G _ h
  have e0 (X0 X1 X2 : G) : (X0 ◇ (X1 ◇ ((X1 ◇ X1) ◇ X2))) = X1 := by
    exact (h X1 X0 X2).symm
  have e1 (X0 X1 X2 : G) : (X0 ◇ (X1 ◇ X2)) = X1 := by
    exact (congrArg (fun q => (X0 ◇ (X1 ◇ q))) (e0 (X1 ◇ X1) X2 X0)).symm.trans (e0 X0 X1 (X2 ◇ ((X2 ◇ X2) ◇ X0)))
  have e2 (X0 X1 X2 : G) : (X0 ◇ X1) = X2 := by
    exact (congrArg (fun q => (X0 ◇ q)) (e0 X2 X1 X0)).symm.trans (e1 X0 X2 (X1 ◇ ((X1 ◇ X1) ◇ X0)))
  have singleton : ∀ a b : G, a = b := by
    intro a b
    exact (e2 a a a).symm.trans (e2 a a b)
  intro x y z
  exact singleton _ _
